html:
The second Roman emperor, who ruled from 14 to 37 CE. He was the son of Livia by her first marriage, and so the stepson of Augustus.

He was one of Rome's best generals. He fought for years in the Alps, in the Balkans and in Germany, and after the disaster of the Teutoburg Forest he held the Rhine. Augustus made him his heir only after his preferred heirs had died, and forced him to divorce a wife he loved to marry Augustus's daughter Julia. For some years Tiberius withdrew in bitterness to Rhodes.

As emperor he was careful with money and left a full treasury, but he was gloomy and suspicious. Treason trials multiplied. He let the guard commander Sejanus run Rome, then had him killed in 31 CE. From 26 CE he lived on the island of Capri and never returned to the city. Jesus was crucified in Judaea during his reign.

Tacitus painted him as a dark tyrant, a picture many historians now think unfair. He was followed by Caligula.
sum: The second Roman emperor, who ruled from 14 to 37 CE. He was the son of Livia by her first marriage, and so the stepson of Augustus.
